name: su_Au8_MgO100
title: Au8 / MgO(001)
description: Au8 on a frozen 3-layer MgO(001) slab (6x6 primitive surface cells, 216 atoms; NEP89 a = 4.203 A vs exp. 4.212 A), the classic model of size-selected Au_n/MgO catalysts (Ricci et al., Phys. Rev. Lett. 97, 036106 (2006)). The NEP89 putative GM is a flat Au8 island with all 8 Au in contact with the surface (Au-Au 2.74-2.83 A); NEP89 puts single Au atoms on top of O as DFT does, but places the best 3D isomers found (fcc 6+2 bilayers) >= 0.69 eV above the flat GM, whereas DFT finds 3D Au8 on bulk MgO(001) and planar Au8 only on metal-supported MgO films that charge the cluster (Ricci et al. 2006), i.e. NEP89 over-stabilises wetting. e_tol is 0.015 eV because distinct flat isomers lie 0.019 eV above the GM.
